kitDescription: Moran is an Electric AR Defender on Burst I who plays as a taunt-tank and rotation accelerator rather than a damage carry. Her Skill 1 gives her a DEF bonus that grows as she loses HP, and — because Raptures are present from the start of a solo raid — permanently puts her in Fervor, cutting her own 40-second Burst cooldown by 20 seconds so she can burst roughly every rotation. Skill 2 taunts the three highest-ATK enemies when she empties her magazine, gives her tiered emergency Max-HP boosts the first three times she drops below 20% HP, and — while she is in Fervor — knocks 7.48 seconds off every ally's Burst cooldown each time the team enters Full Burst. Her Burst swaps her weapon for 10 seconds: the new weapon hits for 14.7% of final ATK per shot with unlimited ammunition, heals her for 36.14% of the damage she deals, and taunts every enemy. During those same 10 seconds the whole team takes 35.14% less damage and gains DEF and ATK scaled off Moran's own stats (14.85% of her DEF, 42.57% of her ATK). While the swapped weapon is out, every 5th normal attack she lands adds a 47.18%-of-final-ATK hit.

redAssertions: skill1/Fervor structural: `expect(FERVOR[0].block.trigger.kind).toBe('passive')` — driver encodes burstCdr 20 on her own burstCast (re-applied every cycle) rather than a battle-start passive. ENCODING-STYLE divergence, not a faithfulness failure: no engine primitive exists for a permanent CD floor (the blind writer conceded exactly this in its own it.skip note), and a passive one-shot burstCdr (which is what the blind OVERRIDE actually authored, with oncePerBattle:true) would reduce only the FIRST cooldown and under-fire every later rotation. Driver's per-cycle encoding reproduces the kit's 40s→20s continuous semantics and is corroborated frame-by-frame (override note, Run B).

skill1/Fervor behaviour: `castsIn(base) > castsIn(noFervor) || team(base) > team(noFervor)` — FIXTURE-INDUCED. controlComp('moran') = liter/crown/moran/helm fields liter AND moran as two Burst-I casters; .moran-probe3.ts proves moran is the SECONDARY B1 there (5 casts with or without Fervor), so the assertion cannot fire. In the driver's sole-B1 fixture (moran/crown/ada/helm) the same line reads 12 casts vs 6 with Fervor removed.

skill2/team-CDR behaviour: `fullBurstStart(base) > fullBurstStart(noFbCdr) || team(base) > team(noFbCdr)` — same fixture artifact (moran's rotation is pinned behind liter's B1 slot). Driver's sole-B1 fixture: crown 12 → 9 casts and moran 12 → 9 with the block removed.

gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Deals 47.18% of final ATK as additional damage.' — silent on crit. Driver override skill1 rider effect: {kind:'flatDamage', atkPct:47.18} (no crit field). S6 blind: {kind:'flatDamage', atkPct:47.18, crit:true, noRange:true}. S2b specified the routing as 'flatDamage 47.18% of final ATK; rider takes FB by landing timing, default noFb OFF; noRange forced' and did not adjudicate crit. Neither S5 nor the driver's test asserts on crit (S5 asserts only core===false, which both satisfy); the crit bucket is a separate multiplicative major in docs/data/damage-calculation.md, so if the engine default for flatDamage is non-crit the two encodings differ by the crit major on ~270 hits/fight.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Resolve against the repo-wide convention rather than by choice: grep the other shipped overrides for flatDamage riders derived from 'additional damage' prose and check the engine default in src/skills/types.ts / sim.ts. If skill-bucket flatDamage defaults to non-crit and sibling units set crit:true on equivalent lines, set crit:true here; if the default already permits crit, record that in the note so the blank field reads as deliberate. Do NOT pick the branch that moves her board ratio — she is 0.66 COLD and the temptation runs one way.

verdictRationale: Every one of the 14 kit lines is either FAITHFUL (6: the swap-gated 47.18% rider, Fervor's −20s, the team 7.48s FB-entry CDR, the replacive 14.7%/10s weaponSwap, unlimitedAmmo, and the casterAtkPct 42.57% ally grant) or an explicitly DOCUMENTED_GAP (8: DEF-per-HP-lost, both taunts, Perseverance, lifesteal, no-cover, caster-DEF grant), giving faithfulness 1.0. The two catastrophic traps on this kit were both avoided and both PROVEN avoided, not merely asserted: 'Damage Taken ▼35.14%' is encoded as a NEGATIVE ally-held buff (48 applies across the four ally slots, never the boss) whose removal leaves all four unit totals byte-identical under two independently written tests, and 'ATK ▲42.57% of the skill user's ATK' resolves to a flat casterAtkPct add off a Defender's low ATK rather than a target-scaled atkPct. The S3 edit is a genuine faithfulness fix (rider gate fbGate:'inFb' → swapGate:'swapped', the previously-unused exact primitive at types.ts:332 / sim.ts:1684), correctly reported as board-neutral (270 vs 273 riders, ~1% delta) and explicitly NOT sold as a fix for her 0.66 COLD — that residual is documented as footage-blocked throughput with a measured estimate (base AR 12/s from control.mov), a refutation record for the 24/s datamine, and a concrete recipe. Convergence is strong and cross-family: S2b (claude-fable-5) and S6 (claude-opus-5) independently derived the identical load-bearing set AND the swapGate fix; the S5 blind suite runs 17 GREEN / 3 RED / 6 SKIP against the shipped override, and all three REDs are non-findings — two are provably fixture-induced (controlComp fields liter as a competing Burst I, pinning moran to 5 casts either way, so the cadence assertions cannot fire; the driver's sole-B1 fixture shows 12→6 and crown 12→9), and the third is a Fervor trigger-shape divergence where the driver's per-cast burstCdr is the measured-correct reconstruction and the blind's own oncePerBattle passive falls into the exact nearest-wrong S2b named. The single open item is low-severity and convention-dependent: crit-eligibility on the flatDamage rider, unset by the driver and set true by the blind, which the prose does not decide — it is listed as a gotcha but does not score against any line. Same-model residuals the owner should spot-check by hand: (1) the crit convention above, since all four agents share priors about flatDamage defaults; (2) that hitCount:5 under swapGate:'swapped' counts only swapped hits — the 270/1369 ratio and the 4.70s first proc are consistent with it but a global counter with output-gating would produce nearly the same count, so this is inferred rather than isolated; and (3) the unmodeled Fervor STATUS, which makes skill2's 'while in Fervor' gate unconditional — correct on a solo boss where Raptures are always present, but it would silently over-credit if Fervor ever became consumable or windowed.
